title: 雷射隱形切割
summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入內部改質層、裂紋傳播與薄晶粒強度。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore internal modified layers, crack propagation and thin-die strength, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

stages.title: 材料與路徑
stages.description: 針對材料與路徑完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for material and path, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: 光穿透條件｜機制與設計
steps.objective: 針對光穿透條件，把「焦點須位於材料內部，入射面與材料吸收決定可達深度。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For optical penetration, turn "The focus must lie inside the material; entry surface and absorption limit depth." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「光穿透條件」的模型：焦點須位於材料內部，入射面與材料吸收決定可達深度。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「畫光路及表面膜層，辨認遮擋。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for optical penetration: The focus must lie inside the material; entry surface and absorption limit depth. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Draw the optical path and films, identifying obstruction. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 畫光路及表面膜層，辨認遮擋。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Draw the optical path and films, identifying obstruction. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：所有晶圓材料都可共用同一光路。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Using one optical path for every wafer material. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付光穿透條件的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for optical penetration, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

knowledge.title: 光穿透條件：機制

knowledge.textEn: The focus must lie inside the material; entry surface and absorption limit depth.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 畫光路及表面膜層，辨認遮擋。 必須排除的錯判：所有晶圓材料都可共用同一光路。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Draw the optical path and films, identifying obstruction. Misinterpretation to reject: Using one optical path for every wafer material. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「光穿透條件」的機制與設計中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For optical penetration — mechanism and design — which decision or action is justified?
options: 焦點須位於材料內部，入射面與材料吸收決定可達深度。
所有晶圓材料都可共用同一光路
表面看不見痕跡即表示改質失敗
optionsEn: The focus must lie inside the material; entry surface and absorption limit depth.
Using one optical path for every wafer material
Treating invisible surface marks as failed modification
quiz.explanation: 焦點須位於材料內部，入射面與材料吸收決定可達深度。 畫光路及表面膜層，辨認遮擋。 因此不能採用「所有晶圓材料都可共用同一光路」。
quiz.explanationEn: The focus must lie inside the material; entry surface and absorption limit depth. Draw the optical path and films, identifying obstruction. Therefore reject: Using one optical path for every wafer material.

steps.title: 光穿透條件｜證據與診斷
steps.objective: 針對光穿透條件，把「焦點須位於材料內部，入射面與材料吸收決定可達深度。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For optical penetration, turn "The focus must lie inside the material; entry surface and absorption limit depth." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：畫光路及表面膜層，辨認遮擋。 將「所有晶圓材料都可共用同一光路」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Draw the optical path and films, identifying obstruction. Challenge the hypothesis "Using one optical path for every wafer material" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 畫光路及表面膜層，辨認遮擋。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Draw the optical path and films, identifying obstruction. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：所有晶圓材料都可共用同一光路。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Using one optical path for every wafer material. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付光穿透條件的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for optical penetration: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

knowledge.text: 厚度變化改變內部焦點位置相對背面的距離。
knowledge.textEn: Thickness variation changes focus distance from the backside.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 將厚度地圖與焦點基準配準。 必須排除的錯判：名義厚度相同便可省略全片地圖。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Register thickness maps and focal references. Misinterpretation to reject: Skipping wafer maps at equal nominal thickness. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「厚度與焦深」的證據與診斷中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For thickness and focal depth — evidence and diagnosis — which decision or action is justified?
options: 名義厚度相同便可省略全片地圖
擴張距離相同即每條街道受力相同
將厚度地圖與焦點基準配準。
optionsEn: Skipping wafer maps at equal nominal thickness
Equating frame expansion with equal street forces
Register thickness maps and focal references.
quiz.explanation: 厚度變化改變內部焦點位置相對背面的距離。 將厚度地圖與焦點基準配準。 因此不能採用「名義厚度相同便可省略全片地圖」。
quiz.explanationEn: Thickness variation changes focus distance from the backside. Register thickness maps and focal references. Therefore reject: Skipping wafer maps at equal nominal thickness.
